contribution.position: Holding my earlier position, and answering product's claim that 'on reliability, nobody else sees a problem, so I would treat it as settled': that is precisely the gap — nobody on this transcript has examined reliability, but the absence of a counter is not evidence of health. artifact:incident-log records a 30-day error rate of 2.6% against a 0.5% SLO with two sev2 incidents, so reliability is not settled, it is breached. qa cites artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed) and I grant that signal, but test greenness measures what the suite covers, not the production failure modes already on record; ops-runbook and cost-sheet say nothing about this axis either. No new artifact or datum bearing on reliability has appeared since my last turn, so there is no basis to update: shipping while the SLO is already breached compounds the customer-facing exposure until the incident drivers are understood and the error rate is back within budget.
